title: SEO & AI Search Visibility Specialist
why_it_fits: SEO match. 2 skills: excel, word. Yes PH eligibility signal
position_overview:
About BuzzyBooth:

BuzzyBooth helps businesses turn their customers into marketing assets through interactive photo experiences, customer data collection, reviews, social sharing, and SMS marketing.

We're looking for an SEO & AI Search Visibility Specialist who can help BuzzyBooth and our customers become more visible-not just on Google, but across the rapidly growing world of AI-powered search and discovery.

The Role:

This role is ideal for someone who understands how search engines rank content and is excited about the evolution from traditional SEO to AI Search / Generative Engine Optimization (GEO).

You will be responsible for identifying opportunities to improve website rankings, developing content strategies, and finding ways to increase the likelihood that businesses are discovered and recommended by AI platforms such as ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Perplexity, Gemini, and other AI search engines.

You should be highly comfortable using existing SEO tools and data to identify opportunities rather than relying solely on intuition.
key_responsibilities:
What You'll Do:
**Traditional SEO**
- Conduct keyword research and competitive analysis
- Identify high-value keyword opportunities and content gaps
- Analyze competitors and determine why their websites rank
- Develop SEO content strategies designed to increase organic traffic and rankings
- Track keyword rankings, organic traffic, and conversions

**AI Search / AI Visibility**
- Develop strategies for getting businesses and their content surfaced in **ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Perplexity, Gemini, and other AI search platforms**
- Research how AI search engines discover, understand, and cite businesses and websites
- Identify content opportunities that can increase a brand's visibility in AI-generated answers
- Develop content specifically designed to answer the questions customers are asking AI
- Analyze which websites, sources, and content are being referenced by AI platforms
- Monitor AI visibility and identify opportunities to improve brand/entity mentions
- Experiment with **Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), Answer Engine Optimization (AEO), and AI SEO**
- Build repeatable strategies for improving AI visibility across different industries
qualifications:
What We're Looking For:
- 2+ years of hands-on SEO experience
- Strong understanding of Google search ranking factors and modern SEO
- Strong keyword research and competitive analysis skills
- Experience developing SEO content strategies
- Understanding of on-page SEO, internal linking, technical SEO, and content optimization
- Strong analytical and research skills
- Ability to turn data into actionable recommendations
- Excellent written communication

**Strongly Preferred:**
- Hands-on experience with **AI search / GEO / AEO / AI visibility**
- Experience optimizing content for ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, Gemini, or similar platforms
- Experience measuring or tracking brand visibility in AI search
- Understanding of how LLMs discover, interpret, and reference web content

The Person We're Looking For:

We're looking for someone who is curious, analytical, experimental, and obsessed with figuring out why something ranks.

You don't need to have every answer. You do need to know how to research, test hypotheses, analyze data, and turn what you learn into a repeatable strategy.

Success in This Role:

Success will be measured by your ability to:
- Increase organic search rankings
- Grow qualified organic traffic
- Identify and capture new keyword opportunities
- Increase the number of pages ranking on Google
- Improve visibility for high-intent searches
- Increase brand/business mentions across AI search platforms
- Develop content that gets referenced or cited by AI platforms
- Build repeatable SEO and AI visibility strategies for BuzzyBooth and its customers

Work remotely, flexible hours. Fun team. Great brand.
